blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The current proxy EIP-1967 implementation slot binds verified HKGXToken. Its ABI exposes freezeAccount, unfreezeAccount, isFrozen and forceBurn with privileged freeze/burn roles; direct holder controls are distinct from mint authority.

oracleRisk.summary: The exact HKGXToken mint and transfer code operates on token quantities and has no price-feed or price-based liquidation path. Physical issuance and delivery are defined in grams (1 gram per token; 1,000-token minimum delivery), not an oracle-valued collateral debt position. Market quotes do not govern the token's native issuance or physical claim.

sources.label: Exact HKGXToken source; quantity mint and transfers
GoldZip fixed-gram physical issuance and delivery terms

branchApplicability.rationale: Physical gold claim uses fixed grams and the token code has no borrower markets, collateral-price comparison or liquidation entrypoint. Absence of an oracle does not verify actual gold allocation or backing.

applicability.rationale: Exact quantity-only token implementation and fixed-gram redemption terms contain no price-sensitive collateral or borrower branch.
